info.name: TapWallet REST API (Assignment 4)
info.description:
Spring Boot REST API for the TapWallet digital wallet.

Run the app (mvn spring-boot:run), then run folders top to bottom: Users -> Wallets -> Merchants -> Payments. Requests save created ids into collection variables (userId, walletId, merchantId, paymentId). Requests prefixed [Rule] demonstrate a business rule and expect an error status.

Seed data: users 1-5 (1 admin, 2-3 customers Alice/Eric, 4-5 merchant operators), wallets 1-2 (Alice 50000 RWF, Eric 12000 RWF), merchants 1-2 (CAF-001 Kigali Cafe, SHP-002 Nyarugenge Shop).

request.description: Creates a customer. Saves the new id into {{userId}}.

exec: const j = pm.response.json(); if (j.id) pm.collectionVariables.set("userId", j.id);

request.description: Creates a MERCHANT-role user. Saves id into {{merchantUserId}}.
Bean Validation rejects every field and lists them in fieldErrors.

request.description: Alice (id 2) owns wallet 1, so she cannot be deleted.
Throwaway user for the delete demo.

exec: const j = pm.response.json(); if (j.id) pm.collectionVariables.set("tempUserId", j.id);

request.description: Opens a wallet for {{userId}}. Saves id into {{walletId}}.

exec: const j = pm.response.json(); if (j.id) pm.collectionVariables.set("walletId", j.id);

request.description: The wallet was frozen by the previous request.
Withdraw everything first (balance must be 0 and no payment history).
Registers a shop for {{merchantUserId}}. Saves id into {{merchantId}}.

exec: const j = pm.response.json(); if (j.id) pm.collectionVariables.set("merchantId", j.id);

request.description: Only allowed while the merchant has no payment history.
Debits wallet 1, credits merchant 1 revenue, records the payment. All in one transaction.

exec: const j = pm.response.json(); if (j.id) pm.collectionVariables.set("paymentId", j.id);
